data.name: Reigning Cats
data.detailed_description:
Características


Nova atualização

Fully migrated the project from the original GameMaker 1.4 source to GameMaker Studio 2024.

Converted the game to run at a clean fixed 60 FPS.


Acerca do jogo

Help Kingkat to defend the castle while waiting for his owner to come back for him (or so he thinks). Hire warriors, archers, rogues, berserkers, mages, or priests and upgrade their skills to aid you in battle against wave after wave of angry dogs.

FEATURES:

  • The main game includes the story, skills to be upgraded, items to be unlocked, 2 mini games(Chow and Potty), and 3 additional game modes. "Revenge of The Big Bad Wolf", "War, War Never Ends", and "Survive the Night"

  • 6 different classes of cats. Each with 2 jobs and 2 modes to be used against dogs.

  • 13 different breed of dogs and a secret final enemy to defend Kingkat from.

  • 4 Mini Bosses and 1 Final Boss

  • Send Cats to venture forth for additional gold and challenge to the game.

  • Night, Day, and Weather affects the game-play.

  • Be able to plan ahead for randomized boss encounter and to think of a strategy for your hirelings placements.

  • Feed Cats and clean up their litter box.

Unlock 3 Additional Game Modes:

"REVENGE OF THE BIG BAD WOLF"

Play as The Big Bad Wolf, and call out for reinforcements to attack and capture Kingkat.

Features:

- New unlockable content included in the game. (Not as DLC)

- Play as the Big Dog and command your pack to attack the cats.

- Strategically pick within 5 available cards at your disposal or reshuffle it.

- Total of 22 cards to use, 13 different dog cardsand 9 skill cards

"WAR, WAR NEVER ENDS"

Continue the battle between Cats and Dogs. Only this time, it will be an all out war.

Features:

- Play the game against randomly selected dogs.

- Mini bosses will appear whenever they want to.

"SURVIVE THE NIGHT"

You must defend the castle at all cost against some weird things that's going on.

Features:

- Enemies are green and weird! They don't act like they normally would.

- Your range cats will be visually impaired by the darkness and the fog.

-meow-

data.short_description: A tower defense and pet simulator that combines casual strategy, pet care, and litterbox cleaning. Whether you love cats or wish you had one, Reigning Cats offers a charming adventure for cat lovers, dog lovers, and tower defense fans alike.

reviews.review:
Reigning Cats is a charming strategy and kingdom-management game developed and published by myradann that transforms the traditional concept of ruling a kingdom into a lighthearted adventure centered around cats. While many management games focus on realism, warfare, or complex economic systems, this title embraces a more playful approach. Players are placed in charge of a feline realm where every choice influences the future of the kingdom, creating an experience that balances humor, resource management, and strategic decision-making in an accessible and entertaining way.

The game's greatest strength lies in its simple yet engaging premise. As the ruler of a cat kingdom, players must oversee the growth and stability of their realm while responding to a constant stream of requests, challenges, and unexpected events. Every decision carries consequences that can affect resources, public approval, and the overall well-being of the kingdom. This focus on meaningful choices ensures that players remain actively involved in shaping the direction of their society rather than simply watching systems operate automatically.

Unlike larger strategy titles that often bury players beneath layers of complicated mechanics, Reigning Cats focuses on clarity and accessibility. The management systems are easy to understand, allowing players to quickly grasp the fundamentals of leadership. However, beneath this approachable surface lies enough strategic depth to make decisions feel important. Balancing economic growth, citizen satisfaction, and long-term stability requires careful consideration, especially as new situations emerge and priorities begin to conflict.

The event-driven structure is one of the most effective elements of the game. Throughout each playthrough, players encounter a wide variety of scenarios that require immediate judgment. Some situations may appear humorous on the surface, while others introduce genuine strategic dilemmas. Deciding how to allocate resources, address citizen concerns, or respond to unusual circumstances often forces players to weigh short-term benefits against long-term consequences. This constant stream of choices keeps the gameplay dynamic and prevents the experience from becoming repetitive.

The feline theme is integrated into nearly every aspect of the game. Rather than feeling like a simple visual gimmick, the cat-centered setting influences the tone, characters, and events that define the experience. Citizens, advisors, and other personalities contribute to a world filled with charm and humor. This playful identity gives the game a distinctive character and helps it stand out from more traditional kingdom-management titles.

Visually, Reigning Cats adopts a colorful and inviting art style that complements its whimsical atmosphere. Character designs are expressive, environments are vibrant, and the overall presentation is consistently cheerful. The visuals are not focused on realism or technical complexity, but they succeed in creating a memorable world that players will enjoy spending time in. The art direction reinforces the game's lighthearted tone and helps make even routine management tasks feel enjoyable.

One of the most satisfying aspects of the experience is watching the kingdom develop over time. Successful decisions contribute to growth and prosperity, while poor choices can create new challenges that must be addressed. This gradual progression creates a strong sense of ownership over the realm. As the kingdom expands and becomes more stable, players can see the direct impact of their leadership, making achievements feel meaningful and rewarding.

The pacing is another area where the game performs well. New events and challenges arrive frequently enough to maintain engagement, but the game rarely feels rushed. Players are given the opportunity to consider their options and make thoughtful decisions without excessive pressure. This relaxed tempo makes Reigning Cats an enjoyable experience for both short sessions and longer periods of play.

The sound design supports the overall atmosphere effectively. Pleasant background music and cheerful sound effects contribute to the game's welcoming tone. The audio never overwhelms the gameplay and instead helps create a relaxing environment that complements the strategic decision-making. Together with the visuals, the soundtrack reinforces the game's identity as a lighthearted and enjoyable management experience.

Replayability is enhanced through the variety of choices available. Different decisions can lead to different outcomes, encouraging experimentation and alternative strategies. Players interested in exploring multiple paths or discovering the consequences of different leadership styles will find additional value in repeated playthroughs. This flexibility helps extend the game's lifespan beyond a single successful kingdom.

Another notable strength is the balance between simplicity and depth. Reigning Cats does not attempt to compete with large-scale grand strategy games in terms of complexity. Instead, it focuses on delivering a streamlined experience where every mechanic serves a purpose. This design philosophy makes the game approachable for newcomers while still providing enough strategic considerations to keep experienced players interested.

Although players looking for deep military systems, large-scale diplomacy, or highly detailed economic simulations may find the scope limited, the game succeeds because it remains committed to its vision. Its emphasis on decision-making, kingdom development, and charming presentation creates an experience that feels cohesive and polished. The focus remains on creating an enjoyable management game rather than overwhelming players with unnecessary complexity.

Overall, Reigning Cats is a delightful blend of strategy, simulation, and humor that offers a refreshing take on kingdom management. Its engaging event system, meaningful choices, charming feline theme, and accessible mechanics work together to create a rewarding experience that is easy to enjoy. While it may not be the most complex strategy game available, it excels at providing entertaining decisions and a memorable atmosphere. For players who appreciate management games with personality and charm, Reigning Cats is a surprisingly engaging journey through the responsibilities of ruling a kingdom populated entirely by cats.

Rating: 6/10
